description: Server content webviews (children of window 'main'). Users can add arbitrary LabHub servers, so the remote url grant cannot enumerate origins: URLPattern 'https://*' / 'http://*' match any http(s) origin (hostname wildcard; empty pathname auto-widens to '*'). Exposure is still contained: the navigation guard in webviews.rs only ever loads user-configured server origins in these webviews, and this capability deliberately grants ONLY desktop-notify + opener + event defaults - never core:default or config commands. 'windows' matches the parent window label, which covers every child webview (spike S5).
